ITEM_NAME LIKE '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%'
PROJECT_TYPE LIKE '%' || #TYPE:VARCHAR# || '%'

SELECT PROJECT_TYPE, ITEM_NO, ITEM_ID, ITEM_NAME, DESCRIPTION , SUM(TSTO) TSTO, SUM(SST) SST FROM(SELECT '明细项目' PROJECT_TYPE, TT.ITEM_NO, TT.ITEM_ID, TT.ITEM_NAME, TT.DESCRIPTION, decode(cpny_id, 'TSTO', 1, null) TSTO, decode(cpny_id, 'SST', 1, null) SST FROM (SELECT T.ITEM_NO, T.ITEM_ID, SY1.CONTENT ITEM_NAME, T.DESCRIPTION FROM AR_ITEM T,SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY1 WHERE T.ITEM_NO = SY1.NO(+) AND T.ACTIVITY = 1 AND SY1.LANGUAGE = #interLanguage:VARCHAR#)TT LEFT JOIN AR_ITEM_PARAM PM ON TT.ITEM_NO = PM.ITEM_NO AND PM.ACTIVITY = 1 UNION ALL SELECT '汇总项目' PROJECT_TYPE, PR.ITEM_NO, PR.ITEM_ID, PR.ITEM_NAME, '', decode(cpny_id, 'TSTO', 1, null) TSTO, decode(cpny_id, 'SST', 1, null) SST FROM (SELECT P.ITEM_NO, P.STA_ITEM_ID ITEM_ID, SY2.CONTENT ITEM_NAME, '' FROM AR_STA_ITEM P,SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY2 WHERE P.ITEM_NO = SY2.NO(+) AND P.ACTIVITY = 1 AND SY2.LANGUAGE = #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) PR LEFT JOIN AR_STA_ITEM_PARAM PT ON PR.ITEM_NO = PT.ITEM_NO AND PT.ACTIVITY=1 ) SD
ITEM_ID LIKE '%' || #ITEM_ID:VARCHAR# || '%'
ITEM_NO = #ITEM_NO:NUMERIC#
ITEM_NO = #NO:NUMERIC#
ITEM_NAME LIKE '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%'
PROJECT_TYPE LIKE '%' || #TYPE:VARCHAR# || '%'
TSTO = 1
SST = 1
ORDER BY $sortname$ $sortorder$ ITEM_NAME
group by SD.PROJECT_TYPE, SD.ITEM_NO, SD.ITEM_ID, SD.ITEM_NAME, SD.DESCRIPTION ORDER BY SD.PROJECT_TYPE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM(SELECT PROJECT_TYPE, ITEM_NO, ITEM_ID, ITEM_NAME, DESCRIPTION , SUM(TSTO) TSTO, SUM(SST) SST FROM(SELECT '明细项目' PROJECT_TYPE, TT.ITEM_NO, TT.ITEM_ID, TT.ITEM_NAME, TT.DESCRIPTION, decode(cpny_id, 'TSTO', 1, null) TSTO, decode(cpny_id, 'SST', 1, null) SST FROM (SELECT T.ITEM_NO, T.ITEM_ID, SY1.CONTENT ITEM_NAME, T.DESCRIPTION FROM AR_ITEM T,SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY1 WHERE T.ITEM_NO = SY1.NO(+) AND T.ACTIVITY = 1 AND SY1.LANGUAGE = #interLanguage:VARCHAR#)TT LEFT JOIN AR_ITEM_PARAM PM ON TT.ITEM_NO = PM.ITEM_NO AND PM.ACTIVITY = 1 UNION ALL SELECT '汇总项目' PROJECT_TYPE, PR.ITEM_NO, PR.ITEM_ID, PR.ITEM_NAME, '', decode(cpny_id, 'TSTO', 1, null) TSTO, decode(cpny_id, 'SST', 1, null) SST FROM (SELECT P.ITEM_NO ITEM_NO, P.STA_ITEM_ID ITEM_ID, SY2.CONTENT ITEM_NAME, '' FROM AR_STA_ITEM P,SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY2 WHERE P.ITEM_NO = SY2.NO(+) AND P.ACTIVITY = 1 AND SY2.LANGUAGE = #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) PR LEFT JOIN AR_STA_ITEM_PARAM PT ON PR.ITEM_NO = PT.ITEM_NO AND PT.ACTIVITY = 1 ) SD group by SD.PROJECT_TYPE, SD.ITEM_NO, SD.ITEM_ID, SD.ITEM_NAME, SD.DESCRIPTION ) MM

MM.ITEM_NO = #NO:NUMERIC#
MM.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%'
MM.PROJECT_TYPE LIKE '%' || #TYPE:VARCHAR# || '%'
MM.TSTO = 1
